decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution sits close to the firm's core aviation security and border compliance know-how, and its proven government use (UK e-Borders, over 30 APIS schemes) gives the firm clear evidence it can interpret and build on, so it is a strong keep.

The travel health requirements API builds on the firm's passenger data and document-check expertise, but demand has faded since the pandemic and the website shows no reported results, so the risk is moderate; it stays because it can be integrated with the data and verification platforms at low cost.

The travel and document verification platform builds directly on the firm's established airline and airport document-check knowledge and fits with Product A, so the firm can assimilate feedback and keep improving it.
